purpose: Preserve the pre-ledger public manuscript as historical v1. These files are evidence for claim-lineage research and must not be silently rewritten.
rule: Every entry below MUST be a snapshot copy under claims/v1-snapshot/. Enforced in code by verify_v1_freeze(); a live path in this manifest is a design-time error, not a gate failure to be waited out.
note: All five artifacts are frozen as snapshot copies, not at their live paths, and every snapshot blob is byte-identical to the original (same sha256), so the evidence guarantee is unchanged. History of why: (1) 2026-07-24 -- the manifest froze the LIVE PREDICTIONS.md, which the research lane writes to continuously; commit 69b361a8 legitimately updated a prediction row and, because verify_v1_freeze() precedes rendering, the whole renderer aborted for two days. Fixed 07-25 by snapshotting that one file. (2) 2026-07-26 -- the gate went red again on docs/whitepaper/Synchronism_Whitepaper.pdf, rewritten by build_whitepaper.yml (which runs `git add docs/ whitepaper/build/` on every push to main). Commit 186c80c6 changed 754603 -> 754617 bytes with the source .md byte-identical: a content-free rebuild broke a content freeze. The 07-25 fix had treated the instance; docs/ and the repo-root README/SPINE were still live paths owned by other writers. Fixed by snapshotting all five and enforcing snapshot-only in code. frozen_on records the original 2026-07-23 freeze; frozen_at_commit points at the commit where all five snapshot blobs coexist unchanged.
